narrative.overview: The user-pinned Slipstream gallery reference replaces the Engineering Manual direction. Near-black grounds, warm-white Big Shoulders display type, amber actions and animated real architecture create an expressive engineering identity. Public Sans carries explanations. Homepage, project collection, navigation/themes and dedicated AI surface are documented; blog and homelab retain incumbent interior compositions.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized condensed display, readable compact prose
Default dark, persistent explicit light preference
Three manually selected real project architectures
Visible Ask AI navigation and dedicated chat
Flat rules, tonal surfaces and real architecture images

rules.name: Evidence Rule
rules.body: Architecture illustrates real project relationships, never live telemetry or fabricated outcomes. Preserve sources and confidential-client wording.

rules.name: Motion Control
rules.body: Packet loops pause manually, offscreen and on hidden documents; reduced motion renders static relationships. All information remains available.

rules.name: Theme Persistence
rules.body: The root defaults dark; only portfolio-theme-v2=light selects light. The explicit user toggle persists the choice.

dos: Do use Big Shoulders with Public Sans.
Do keep Ask AI prominent and preserve its dedicated route.
Do preserve keyboard focus, roving architecture tabs and motion controls.
Do retain real diagrams, source actions and all ten projects.
Do hide the retained floating AI launcher and widget below 640px; keep the dedicated AI route reachable through navigation, hero and footer.
donts: Don’t restore the superseded Engineering Manual palette or light-first behavior.
Don’t fabricate telemetry, outcomes, testimonials or client identities.
Don’t claim blog and homelab interiors were fully redesigned.
